description: Exact-source CI compatibility drill between a pinned historical candidate baseline and current so. The baseline is explicitly not a release artifact. Current expanded PostgreSQL migrations are applied first; the baseline SQL and Go integration surfaces must still pass without changing the current memory_os schema fingerprint, then current tests must pass independently. This is a pre-release compatibility foundation, not rolling deployment, downgrade or production mixed-version evidence.

candidateBaseline.selectionReason: Known exact so authority point before the current observability, recovery and chaos work; core import schema and backend existed, but no release approval is claimed.

requiredSteps: verify candidate baseline is an ancestor of current exact source SHA
create a detached read-only worktree at the pinned candidate baseline
create separate baseline-compatibility and current-verification PostgreSQL databases
apply the current canonical migration sequence to both databases
capture the production memory_os schema fingerprint before baseline execution
execute candidate SQL integration tests in the exact order recorded by the baseline migration registry or its own Security Contracts workflow
execute reviewed Go package surfaces that exist in both exact source trees against the expanded schema and local MinIO
capture the production memory_os schema fingerprint after baseline execution and require equality
execute current canonical SQL and common Go integration tests against the separate current database
write exact baseline/current SHAs and bounded counts without credentials or database URLs
successCriteria: candidate baseline is an ancestor of current source
both databases receive all current canonical migrations
all candidate baseline canonical SQL tests pass on current expanded schema
candidate baseline selected Go packages compile and pass
baseline execution does not change the current memory_os schema fingerprint
all current canonical SQL tests pass
current selected Go packages compile and pass
no secret, database URL, object key, token or user content enters evidence
result remains classified as candidate compatibility rather than release or production evidence
abortCriteria: baseline SHA is missing, not an ancestor or differs from the contract
source or target database identity is ambiguous
current migration sequence cannot apply cleanly
baseline has neither a migration registry nor an ordered Security Contracts workflow
any baseline SQL or common Go test fails
memory_os schema fingerprint changes after baseline execution
any current SQL or common Go test fails
evidence would include credentials, connection URLs or user content
limitations: candidate baseline is not an approved release
separate databases rather than simultaneous old/current traffic
local MinIO rather than production object storage
no rolling deployment order or connection-drain failure injection
no downgrade or destructive contract migration
